scenario: RuleDebugName template shape per RDSC.6.8.4 for one positive pattern over a schema keyed on `entity_id`: rule name, then `(s={s.entity_id})`. `test_conformance.m` reads the RuleDebugName atom's name_template out of the emitted `.dsc`; the expected string ends in `)`, so an extra entry would not match.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    level: Float mutable

rule alert_high:
    Sensor s where s.level > 90.0
->
    log info "high: {s.entity_id}"
